exposure: Type A: enlargement of the anterior horn
Type B: enlargement from the body to the posterior horn
Type C: whole enlargement from the anterior to the posterior horn
cohort: Infants with a gestational age of 36 weeks or greater.
finding: Slightly lateral ventricular enlargement in infants was correlated with various factors including cesarean delivery, gestational age, birth weight, respiratory issues, and different types of ventricular enlargement showed specific associations with other conditions like intrauterine growth restriction and placenta previa.
